_comment: The docs graph's SUB-GRAPHS, declared from within -- the same shape as the base harness's own `docs/docs.json`, paths relative to THIS file's directory.
name: folio-assistant-core

directories.description: This layer's docs SOURCE: one directory per generated page (`<group>-<slug>/`), holding its authored blocks (`.md`), its manifests (`.ts`) and their generated `.jsonld`. The platform's one docs-page run (`gen-docs-pages.ts`, owner ruling A1 of 2026-10-23: it reads the docs source every mounted layer declares) renders each into the page beside it (`docs/<group>/<slug>.md`), and the site build composes this directory under `/folio-assistant-core/`. `compose-docs` leaves this directory out, so a block is never published as a page of its own. Moved here from the harness below on 2026-10-23 (wrong-direction move M6): these pages document this layer's own processes.
